name: What types of baseboard materials are available?
description: Available materials include MDF, solid wood (pine, oak, poplar), and PVC; choose based on cost, durability, and moisture exposure.

mainEntity.name: What types of baseboard materials are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common baseboard materials include Medium-Density Fiberboard (MDF), solid wood (like pine, oak, or poplar), and occasionally PVC or composite materials. MDF is cost-effective and paintable, while solid wood offers durability and natural beauty. When making a decision, consider the room's moisture levels and the desired durability; MDF is less suitable for high-moisture areas like bathrooms.
